decisions.summary: _board_routes takes each road's recorded width (road_width, roads[i].w, a main street's w, all in px as ground.py records them) instead of a fixed 18 px; the claim re-cited from 0137 (capital) to 0088 (the per-tier road widths)
decisions.why: row 169's fix verbatim: recorded width instead of 18 px, cite the per-tier widths not the capital page; ground.py records the drawn width in px, so no further conversion is owed

decisions.summary: all three caption steps (board_caption_seat, terminal_caption, fallback_caption) proved against board_record's drawn vw x vh, the same box board_subject draws
decisions.why: row 170's fix verbatim; the steps double the half-extents into board_subject/recorded_board, so the proof subject is the drawn footing

decisions.summary: a road or main street with no recorded width falls back to the drawers' defaults lw(ROAD_W_FT) 30 ft and lw(STREET_W_FT) 24 ft (STREET_W_FT named in lanes.py, street() reads it) instead of 18 px, in the main-way and whole-network routes
decisions.why: a defect impl-drift found in the unit the row fixes; moves the implementation to 0088/0136 (FR-004, XIV); behavior-preserving where a width is recorded (every hamlet way does, measured)

decisions.summary: the same width fallbacks applied in place_punishment_spot, a DEFERRED unit, with its width, lane-fallback and turn decisions claimed
decisions.why: deferral (FR-010) permits not fixing legacy-only code; it does not forbid a consistency edit, and the edit moves code toward the research the GM asked for; no hand-rolled map file is edited (FR-009)

decisions.summary: facing search pad NONE, siting default frontage (0190), bed clearance UNRESEARCHED newly claimed on place_kosatsuba
decisions.why: UNCLAIMED findings are in the feature's scope (FR-001); labeling them is the record the feature exists to complete

decisions.summary: the web-lane test holds the board inside the web lane's 60 ft band (KOSATSUBA_WAY_REACH_FT, measured from centerline) instead of within 40 px of its centerline; the board measured at 47.5 ft, caption clean
decisions.why: the 40 px was the test's own figure, not the research's; the new bound is 0190's reach, measured from the centerline (stricter than the code's edge-to-footing cap), and the test still asserts the web lane is taken and the hemmed main lane is not

decisions.summary: place_kosatsuba#placement knob at the lane tiers left DRIFTED to its ranked E3 row 204
decisions.why: the GM asked for easiest to hardest; FR-003/SC-003 hold an E3 row until the E2 rows are done, so leaving it to its row is the requested order, not a carve-out

decisions.summary: place_punishment_spot#within 60 ft of a street (DRIFTED) and two unclaimed decisions in that unit left DEFERRED
decisions.why: the GM's own words (amendment 8): legacy hand-drawn settlements' findings marked DEFERRED, scope = code executed by magistracies, country shrines and scripted hamlets; dev/claims-deferred.json, derived by audit/scope.py from the run records, lists place_punishment_spot as deferred - a measured scope, not a remembered one

decisions.summary: the every-seat-fouled unit test grows 28.3 -> 36.5 s, profiled (359 terminal searches x ~2,400 seats against the larger subject) and recorded in m:wave64-board-widths-and-caption, left to the batch close
decisions.why: the request says nothing of test time; the growth is measured, its mechanism recorded, and the GM's 2026-10-08 batching ruling puts the gate (with ratchet.py) and the timing pair at the batch close. Note: the timing pair measures the kept maps, not this test - the gate's ratchet at the batch close is what judges it
